body: While working on https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaUtilities.jl/pull/258, I discovered (with help from LLM) that the ragged time varying input does not work on GPU due to `promote` not being type stable on Julia 1.10 and 1.11. This PR fixes that. Note that `promote` is not type stable when the number of inputs increase. For example, `promote` is not type stable for the number of inputs is 32. Using `UnrolledUtilities` might be required here, but is not needed right now.
title: Make promote for ITime type stable

body: To avoid concurrency issues, this PR makes CI on MacOS run only on PR merges. This PR also fixes two bugs where the first bug is that  CI only run on Ubuntu and the second bug is code coverage being uploaded by all jobs running Julia tests.
title: Run CI on MacOS only on PR merges
